definitions.explanation: A person who is traveling, especially for leisure or sightseeing. Emphasizes the person's role as a customer or visitor.

examples.japanese: {旅行客|りょこうきゃく}で{賑|にぎ}わっている。
{外国人|がいこくじん}{旅行客|りょこうきゃく}が{年々|ねんねん}{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: The number of foreign tourists is increasing year by year.

examples.japanese: {京都|きょうと}は{春|はる}になると{旅行客|りょこうきゃく}が{桜|さくら}を{目当|めあ}てに{大勢|おおぜい}{訪|おとず}れる。
examples.english: In spring, many travelers visit Kyoto to see the cherry blossoms.

notes:
A compound of {旅行|りょこう} (travel) and {客|きゃく} (customer/guest). Views the traveler from the perspective of the tourism or hospitality industry — as a customer or visitor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外国人|がいこくじん}{旅行客|りょこうきゃく}: foreign tourist
- {旅行客|りょこうきゃく}が{増|ふ}える: tourists increase
- {旅行客|りょこうきゃく}を{呼|よ}び{込|こ}む: to attract tourists
- {旅行客|りょこうきゃく}で{賑|にぎ}わう: to be bustling with travelers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {観光客|かんこうきゃく}: sightseer; tourist — focuses on sightseeing specifically; the most common word for tourist
- {旅行者|りょこうしゃ}: traveler — more neutral; does not carry the "customer" nuance of {客|きゃく}
- {旅人|たびびと}: traveler — literary or poetic; evokes a wanderer or journeyer
